scope: Selected Qwen2.5-VL evaluation paths and Llava-OneVision Qwen2 baselines. Selected DecoupleKV branding is renamed to KVRepack in owned code; original source paths, bytes, hashes and source AST fingerprints remain unchanged. No improved LLaVA algorithm is introduced. LookM now has an explicitly declared behavioral patch for strict total prefill budget and correct head-local merging; it is no longer claimed AST-identical to the old LookM adaptation.

transform_definitions.rename_python_import_root: Replace the root hybridkv only in Python import/from statements with kvrepack; do not rename algorithm variables, class names, method names or environment literals.
transform_definitions.rename_cuda_module: Replace whole-word mmko_kernel identifiers with kvrepack_kernel, including matching commented kernel examples.
transform_definitions.relocate_head_score_resources: Only load_head_score resource location changes: parent/visual_head/head_score -> package/data/head_score using __file__. JSON bytes are unchanged.
transform_definitions.redirect_private_asymkv_helpers: Official generation imports the same helper functions from kvrepack._asymkv_helpers instead of hybridkv.asymkv_paper.generation.
transform_definitions.extract_private_asymkv_helpers: Copy five complete function definitions, including decorators, from asymkv_paper/generation.py; add only their needed imports. Do not expose or copy the paper generation method.
transform_definitions.extract_internal_asymkv_reducer: Copy only reduce_groups_asymkv unchanged to satisfy the delayed import in preserved HybridKVCache; omit Hybrid-AsymKV generation and probe code.
transform_definitions.retain_selected_qwen_dispatch: Keep selected method branch bodies unchanged after import renaming. Remove unselected dispatcher branches and their unreachable headsplit token-mask setup. Keep generation prepare wrapper with only its unreachable mask-setting if removed.
transform_definitions.copy_resource_bytes: Copy required configuration or head-score JSON bytes without content changes.
transform_definitions.append_llava_dispatcher_with_local_impor: Append only opensource replace_llava_onevision, whose four selected branch bodies remain AST-identical. Add two function-local imports of the corresponding artifact-derived implementations and an explicit unsupported-method exception. Existing Qwen function AST is unchanged.

rename_decouplekv_brand.scope: Owned Python code text, including identifiers, environment names, method strings, docstrings and comments. Five module filenames follow the same lowercase rule. Historical source paths and entrypoint references are protected. RandomDecoupledKV and ordinary decoupled are preserved.
rename_decouplekv_brand.reversibility: Each changed file records exact target character spans and original/replacement fragments. Reverse these spans to recover the previous integration bytes and SHA-256; replay ordered rules to recover current bytes. A global inverse replacement is intentionally not used.
rename_decouplekv_brand.algorithm_verification: Apply identical ordered rules to the original source text before existing import/kernel/resource normalization and compare complete or selected ASTs. Original pre-branding source AST fingerprints are retained; derived renamed_source_* fingerprints are added.

transform_definitions.lookm_total_prefill_budget_and_head_loca: After the preserved mechanical integration, apply the shipped exact unified diff. Reverse declared text spans to prove the prior target SHA, verify before/after AST of only two functions, restore those functions to prove the remainder is unchanged, then compare the original source AST against the recovered integration.

validation_plan.mechanical_copy: Apply declared import/kernel/resource-location changes to source and compare full ast.dump(include_attributes=False) with target.
validation_plan.selected_functions: Find each selected function by name in source and target; require identical function AST hashes, including decorators and default arguments.
validation_plan.selected_dispatcher: Compare every retained method branch body AST after package import normalization; compare prepare_inputs_for_generation_qwen AST after removing exactly the recorded unreachable token-mask if. Assert removed methods have no dispatcher branch.
validation_plan.resources: Require source and target SHA-256 equality.
validation_plan.llava_dispatcher: Compare all four retained branch bodies with opensource replace_llava_onevision. Remove only two leading imports and final fallback else, then compare the whole function AST. Require unchanged Qwen function AST.
validation_plan.branding: Reverse span edits and verify previous target SHA, replay exact ordered naming rules, verify old source AST against recovered integration AST and branded original source AST against new target AST. No AST normalization removes arithmetic, branching, function arguments or non-brand string values.
validation_plan.behavior_patch: Verify reversible patch and full unchanged AST outside declared definitions; compare unmodified original-source normalization to recovered pre-fix target. Never replace original source hashes with corrected target hashes.

def replace_llava_onevision(method):
    from kvrepack.qwen2_model import (
        qwen2_flash_attn2_forward_SnapKV,
        qwen2_flash_attn2_forward_SparseMM,
        qwen2_flash_attn2_forward_LookM,
        qwen2_flash_attn2_forward_MadaKV,
        sparsemm_qwen2_forward,
        lookm_qwen2_forward,
        madakv_qwen2_forward,
        decoder_qwen2_forward_sparsemm,
        decoder_qwen2_forward_lookm,
        decoder_qwen2_forward_madakv,
    )
    from kvrepack.modeling_llava_onevision import LlavaOnevisionModel

    if method == "snapkv":
        print("Using SnapKV on LlavaOneVision!")
        transformers.models.qwen2.modeling_qwen2.Qwen2Attention.forward = qwen2_flash_attn2_forward_SnapKV
    
    elif method == "sparsemm":
        print("Using SparseMM on LlavaOneVision!")
        transformers.models.qwen2.modeling_qwen2.Qwen2Model.forward = sparsemm_qwen2_forward  # DynamicSplitCache
        transformers.models.qwen2.modeling_qwen2.Qwen2DecoderLayer.forward = decoder_qwen2_forward_sparsemm # decoder need past the past_key_value
        transformers.models.qwen2.modeling_qwen2.Qwen2Attention.forward = qwen2_flash_attn2_forward_SparseMM
    
    elif method == "lookm":
        print("Using LookM on LlavaOneVision!")
        transformers.models.llava_onevision.modeling_llava_onevision.LlavaOnevisionModel.forward = LlavaOnevisionModel.forward # is_vision_token_mask past
        transformers.models.qwen2.modeling_qwen2.Qwen2Model.forward = lookm_qwen2_forward # past vision mask
        transformers.models.qwen2.modeling_qwen2.Qwen2DecoderLayer.forward = decoder_qwen2_forward_lookm # past vision mask
        transformers.models.qwen2.modeling_qwen2.Qwen2Attention.forward = qwen2_flash_attn2_forward_LookM # past vision mask & actual pruning

    elif method == "madakv":
        print("Using MadaKV in LlavaOneVison!")
        transformers.models.llava_onevision.modeling_llava_onevision.LlavaOnevisionModel.forward = LlavaOnevisionModel.forward # is_vision_token_mask past
        transformers.models.qwen2.modeling_qwen2.Qwen2Model.forward = madakv_qwen2_forward # past vision mask & next-layer budget
        transformers.models.qwen2.modeling_qwen2.Qwen2DecoderLayer.forward = decoder_qwen2_forward_madakv # past vision mask & next-layer budget
        transformers.models.qwen2.modeling_qwen2.Qwen2Attention.forward = qwen2_flash_attn2_forward_MadaKV # past vision mask & next-layer budget with updating
    else:
        raise NotImplementedError(f"Unsupported LlavaOnevision method: {method}")

source_selection_notes: artifact llava_ov_ratio.sh currently selects fullkv/lookm/snapkv; sparsemm/madakv are optional branches already implemented in its companion opensource dispatcher and artifact qwen2_model.

artifact monkeypatch.py omits replace_llava_onevision, so its original baseline call path is incomplete. This integration explicitly uses the existing opensource dispatch assignments with artifact-derived functions.

qwen2_model imports modeling_qwen2, which imports hybridkv_cpu and its CUDA extension at module import time. All four patched Llava baselines therefore require kvrepack_kernel even when a given baseline does not call a custom kernel.
HybridKV uses the original artifact param_config.json, including llava_ov.budget_fixed_ratio=0.1; the opensource config has a different 0.5 value and is not substituted.
API presence and AST checks do not establish GPU correctness or numerical equivalence.
